text:
Jess: Oh my god, Ryan, last night was unreal. I'm still hoarse.
Ryan: I know, I saw your stories. Did you get the front section?
Jess: No, we were about, like, twenty rows back, but honestly the sound was amazing. They opened with the new single, and then straight into the old stuff, all the songs from the first album.
Ryan: I'm so jealous. I tried to get tickets but they sold out in, what, six minutes?
Jess: Yeah, I was in the queue online for like an hour. Eighty-nine thousand people in front of me at one point. But Kate got us two through some friend's friend.
Ryan: Lucky. How long was the set?
Jess: Two and a half hours, plus an encore. The singer talked a lot between songs, told this long story about how they recorded their first demo in a garage and the neighbour called the police.
Ryan: Ha, that's great. Did they play the slow one, the one with the piano?
Jess: Yes! Everyone turned on their phone flashlights, it looked like a sea of stars. I got a little teary, not gonna lie.
Ryan: Stop it. Okay, now I really regret not going. Any chance they come back next year?
Jess: They announced a second leg in the spring. Tickets go on sale on Friday at ten.
Ryan: Right, I'm setting an alarm. Can you send me the link?
Jess: Sending it now. And bring earplugs, trust me.
Ryan: Will do. Thanks, Jess!
